scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:attestcoin && npm run check:contracts

scripts.check:attestcoin: npm --prefix packages/attestcoin run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/attestcoin test && npm --prefix packages/attestcoin run build
scripts.check:contracts: forge fmt --root contracts --check && forge build --root contracts --sizes && forge test --root contracts && forge lint --root contracts
